subject: IPDF status: SYMSOL repro green, eval-grid memory is the risk for next week
body:
Dmitri, Santiago,

Status before the big week. SYMSOL I repro is green with the released recipe (random SO(3) sampling, 3 Fourier components, the [256,256,256,256] head, 100k iterations): distributions on the symmetric shapes come out properly multi-modal - the cube's 24-fold symmetry shows up as 24 clean modes - and average log-likelihood matches the published numbers within tolerance. The 4-Fourier-component cube config also reproduces.

The risk for the sweep: memory. At 2M+ rotation queries per example the eval batches blow past single-GPU memory unless test_batch_size stays at 1 and queries are chunked; Leilani's dry run at 1/10 scale caught a chunking bug that would have OOMed us mid-sweep on the real thing. Fixed, and the dry run now projects the full suite comfortably inside our reserved week - with about 20% headroom, which I'd like to keep as slack rather than adding configs.

Integration prototype: Nikhil has IPDF uncertainty wired into the labeling gate on a 500-part sample; early precision numbers look promising and go in the next update.

Katya
